question: Galo is a Tani language spoken in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Languages like Nyishi, Apatani, Bokar, Galo, Tagin, Adi are widely spoken in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• It falls under the Tani dialect (a type of Tibeto-Burman language).
 
• However, in the eastern part of the state, it is the Mishmi language which is widely spoken.
 
• In the west and the north, people speak the Bodic language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Mukhota Dance is a sword dance performed by the Galo tribe of Arunachal Pradesh. 
 
• It is a classical dance that has been performed by the Galo tribe for many years. 
 
• The dance is performed to celebrate the harvest and to pray for a good year ahead. 
 
• The dancers wear colorful costumes and masks, and they wield swords and shields as they dance
 
• The dance is performed to the beat of drums and cymbals, and it is a celebration of strength, courage, and victory.
